narrative: Material PL2__MB1EA898 exhibits erratic demand with CV=0.420 and unstable lead times (CV=0.653). Mean daily demand is 3332 units with an effective lead time of 2.8 days. The optimized policy recommends a safety stock of 6,842 units (vs. current 5,652), a reorder point of 16,291 units, and an order quantity of 44,593 units (vs. current 13,565). This optimization achieves annual cost savings of $1920.32 (59.4%), primarily through reduced ordering frequency and balanced inventory levels. The storage capacity constraint is active, limiting order quantity to available space. Safety lead time can be reduced from 3.5 to 2.0 days based on observed lead time variability.
warnings: Order quantity constrained by storage capacity
